title: Developer Guide for foundr
text: 8 Collaborative Cross (CC) founder strains :AJ, B6, 129, NOD, NZO, CAST, PWK, WSB. Strain color palettes stored CCcolors (Okabe-Ito color-blind friendly palette).

title: Developer Guide for foundr
text: Orthogonal Variance Partitioning (R/partition.R):partition() decomposes trait values signal (strain x sex x condition), rest (nuisance/experimental controls), noise (residuals). Statistical Summaries & ANOVA (R/strainstats.R):strainstats() computes linear model parameters, F-statistics, SD, cell means across strain/sex/condition groups. Trait Structures (S3 Classes): traitSolos: Single trait evaluation across strains traitPairs: Paired trait relationship analysis (correlations, scatter plots) traitTimes: Time-series trait trajectories time conditionContrasts: Experimental condition contrast metrics S3 Generics & Method Dispatch: Standard S3 methods implemented across trait objects include:autoplot(), plot(), summary(), subset(), split(), c(). Visualization Design System: Master ggplot formatting defined ggplot_template() (R/ggplot_template.R) ensuring uniform typography, Okabe-Ito CC color palettes, dynamic faceted layouts. PCA biplots leverage ordr package (biplot_signal(), biplot_stat(), biplot_pca()).

title: Data Pipeline & Statistical Methodology
text: partition() function (R/partition.R) separates phenotypic variance three mutually orthogonal components: value=signal+rest+noise\text{value} = \text{signal} + \text{rest} + \text{noise}

title: Data Pipeline & Statistical Methodology
text: Reduced Model (Rest Estimation): Fit reduced linear model predicting trait value nuisance/experimental control factors (rest\text{rest}): value∼rest\text{value} \sim \text{rest}rest̂=predict(fitred),ered=value−rest̂\widehat{\text{rest}} = \text{predict}(\text{fit}_{\text{red}}), \quad e_{\text{red}} = \text{value} - \widehat{\text{rest}} Full Model (Signal Estimation): Fit residuals reduced model (erede_{\text{red}}) signal factors (signal\text{signal}): ered∼signale_{\text{red}} \sim \text{signal}signal̂=predict(fitfull)\widehat{\text{signal}} = \text{predict}(\text{fit}_{\text{full}}) Cell Mean Calculation: cellmean=signal̂+rest̂\text{cellmean} = \widehat{\text{signal}} + \widehat{\text{rest}} default: - condition present: signal = "strain * sex * condition", rest = "strain * sex + sex * condition". - condition absent: signal = "strain * sex", rest = "sex".

title: GGplot template for other routines — ggplot_template
text: template consists wrapper (`ggplot_template`) make multiple calls create individual ggplot objects (`ggplot_onerow`). `object` list constructed routines (`ggpot_traitSolos`, `ggplot_traitPairs`, `ggplot_traitTimes`) distinct ways. Signals passed subtle ways routines adapted distinct uses: shape_sexdifferent shapes `sex` `TRUE` () facet_strainfacet `strain` `TRUE` (Solos, Pairs); used tricky ways Times legend_position"none" (Solos, Pairs) "bottom" (Times) drop_xlabdrop xlab last ggplot object (Solos, Times) parallel_lines peculiarities deeply embedded attributes either `object` elements list `object.` traitnamestrait names `dataset: trait` (`object` ) response"value","cellmean","signal" (Solos,Pairs) smooth_method"lm" (Solos,Pairs), "loess" (timetype == "strain"; Times), "line" (timetype == "stats"; Times) pairpair traits (Pairs), "time" trait name (Times) sepseparator " " (Pairs) timetype"strain","stats" (Times) time"minute","week" (timetype == "strain") "minute_summary","week_summary" (timetype == "stats") (Times) addition presence absence column "condition" affects whether faceting coloring based "sex" "sex_condition". Typically, parameter `facet_strain` controls facet vs color: `TRUE`, facet `strain` color `sex` `condition`; `FALSE` facet `sex` `condition` color `strain`; however, Times plot `response` == "value", color `strain`.
